about_the_game:
Typingvania is a typing trainer with a focus on variety and accuracy where you type words from real books tailored to your current skill.

Key features

  • Type words from a real book with all the flowery and evocative language, not the same 1,000 most common words or random quotes, including numbers and punctuation.

  • Typingvania tracks your every keystroke and schedules words that will be the most effective to get you typing evenly and accurately across the whole keyboard, starting with the most frequent letters.

  • There are no timers or mechanics that force you to type as fast as you can. Speed comes with accuracy and the game will gently push you to be highly accurate.
